name: kreative-krew
description: Turn your Claude Code sessions into an engineering crew run by a Manager session: approved briefs, evidence inbox, burnout detection with automatic succession, collision radar, merge refinery and a live dashboard.

fastModel.title: Fast model
fastModel.description: Model for cards, digests, drafts and messages between sessions

smartModel.title: Smart model
smartModel.description: Model for brief compiling, judging and handoff audits

workerModel.title: Worker model
workerModel.description: Model new workers start with (empty: your default)

hireMode.description: How new workers start: background sessions or tmux windows

rotateAt.title: Planned rotation at context %
rotateAt.description: A worker past this context % is rotated at its next natural boundary

defaultBudgetUsd.title: Default task budget (USD)
defaultBudgetUsd.description: Budget a brief gets when it does not set one

canary.title: Canary quiz

claudeArgs.title: Extra claude arguments
claudeArgs.description: Extra arguments for every hired worker, space separated

standingRules.title: Standing rules
